description: This file defines the LeavePeriodService class, which manages leave periods within the HRM system. It provides methods to generate leave periods, retrieve current leave periods, and handle related date calculations and data access.

classes.name: LeavePeriodService
classes.description: Service class for managing leave periods, including generation, retrieval, and date calculations related to employee leave periods.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeavePeriodDao instance used for database operations related to leave periods.

methods.name: getListOfMonths
methods.description: Returns a list of all month names in a year.

methods.name: getMonthNumberList
methods.description: Provides an array of month numbers from 1 to 12.

methods.name: getListOfDates
methods.description: Returns an array of valid dates for a specific month, considering leap years.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the start date and month of the current leave period, optionally forcing a reload from the database.

methods.name: _getLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Fetches the list of leave period histories, optionally forcing data reload.

methods.name: getGeneratedLeavePeriodList
methods.description: Generates a list of leave periods up to an optional end date, based on leave period history.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Finds the leave period that includes a specific date.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period if leave periods are defined in the configuration.

methods.name: getNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Provides a normalized array representation of the current leave period.

methods.name: getMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the latest generated leave period, if leave periods are defined.
